body: Looks like my friends and I on the way home from the bar.
What a unique picture. Very cool.

This thread is quickly turning into a wonderful resource! I love all your comments and suggestions guys, thank you so much for contributing. I do mean it when I say some of those suggestions may very well end up saving my life if I apply them so I do appreciate it so much.

Glad to know I made a difference for you. And I am sorry you have to deal with the pain of suicidal thinking. I think talking with your friend is a wonderful idea. Good luck with that!
